c2_event_graph_contract.common_denominator: the same directed event-speed enclosure is retained in the state, first-event, and second-event rows
c2_event_graph_contract.regularity: T belongs to C2 on an open neighborhood of the ball

common_event_window_contract.consequence: exactly one selected event T(x) in I_T for every x in the full ball
common_event_window_contract.window: I_T=[T_minus,T_plus], common to the full ball

complete_returned_history_tube_contract.coverage_interval: all physical times in [T_minus-tau_max,T_plus], not only the event endpoint
complete_returned_history_tube_contract.local_patch_gate: R(x) lies in the declared local Route-C section patch
complete_returned_history_tube_contract.reference_history: X_* at the fixed Route-C return phase
complete_returned_history_tube_contract.returned_history: R(x)=(theta -> v(T(x)+theta;x), w(T(x);x)) for every theta in [-tau_max,0]

coordinate_and_domain_registration.fixed_unit_y_splitting: x=X_*+x_s+q_hat*x_u with x_s in ker(f_hat), ||q_hat||_Y=1, and P_s=I-q_hat*f_hat fixed
coordinate_and_domain_registration.full_ball_quantifier: all ||x_s||_Y<=0.0097 and |x_u|<=0.00025, including arbitrary continuous stable histories
coordinate_and_domain_registration.history_space: Y=C([-tau_max,0],R)_v x R_w with the inherited max norm

directed_cover_interface.event_row_order: form the event gap and speed from the correlated state and vector-field enclosure before testing signs
directed_cover_interface.history_support: each slab covers the complete lag interval needed by every delayed field evaluation
directed_cover_interface.local_patch_distance: use the inherited complete-history Y norm, not a current-state or finite-node proxy
directed_cover_interface.seam_rule: adjacent enclosures overlap or share directed endpoint bounds; no uncovered floating-point seam is allowed
directed_cover_interface.time_partition_boundaries: include t=0, launch collar, every delay activation, every candidate section crossing, T_minus, and T_plus

first_missing_error_term.domain: all initial histories in the Rs=0.0097, Ru_hat=0.00025 ball and all physical times through T_plus
first_missing_error_term.name: full_ball_nonlinear_mild_flow_remainder_in_Y
first_missing_error_term.why_first: endpoint gap, speed, returned-history, no-earlier-return, and event-graph derivative bounds all require this same nonlinear state family

handoff_to_stage4m.supplies_common_domain_for_D2P: only after every Stage-4N numerical ingress and claim gate above is validated

no_earlier_admissible_return_contract.admissible_return: g(X_t(x))=0, Dg[F(X_t(x))]>0, and X_t(x) in the local Route-C return patch
no_earlier_admissible_return_contract.compact_middle_cover: cover [t_launch,T_minus] by directed slabs; on each slab prove at least one exclusion alternative
no_earlier_admissible_return_contract.exclusion_alternatives: section gap excludes zero; or event speed is nonpositive; or every zero lies outside the local complete-history patch
no_earlier_admissible_return_contract.launch_collar: a directed short-time sign/speed argument separates t=0 from every later admissible return

nonlinear_flow_family_contract.acceptable_engines: directed Taylor--Bernstein/method-of-steps enclosure, a validated mild-equation radii argument, or an equivalent continuous-history proof
nonlinear_flow_family_contract.equation: dX/dt=F(X_t), X_0=x in the full anisotropic ball
nonlinear_flow_family_contract.method_of_steps_requirement: include exact initial-history translation before each delay activates, all delayed branches, activation faces, and seams
nonlinear_flow_family_contract.required_state_components: the full voltage history and current recovery coordinate
nonlinear_flow_family_contract.required_uniformity: continuous in physical time and uniform over every initial history in the infinite-dimensional ball

selected_return_definition.local_return_patch: the event hyperplane intersected with one declared complete-history neighborhood of X_*
selected_return_definition.selected_event: the unique positive-oriented hit in one common near-period window whose returned history lies in the local patch

theorem_boundary.not_proved_here: a nonlinear return tube, selected or first return, event graph, Hessian block, stable graph, crossing, onset, routing, capture, or safety theorem
theorem_boundary.proved_here: only the source-bound nonlinear-return/event-graph contract and its dependency order
theorem_boundary.stage4l_substitution: forbidden: a linear terminal stable row has neither the nonlinear base family nor moving-event/no-earlier-hit data

manifest.arithmetic_scope: normal validation and byte binding of the nonclosing Stage-4M contract; exact registration of its preferred-B anisotropic radii; and an open continuous-history nonlinear flow, common-event-window, C2 event-graph, returned-history tube, and no-earlier-admissible-return interface; no Stage-4L numerical ingress and no return-map, Hessian, graph, crossing, onset, routing, capture, or safety promotion

runtime.arithmetic: contract-only exact string registration and source/parent SHA-256 binding; no numerical flow enclosure
